vivid-indigo.$description: Vivid Indigo — Primary action background, filled buttons, active nav, brand focal point — the one chromatic color that carries the entire brand

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Footer background, dark section canvases, heading accent on dark surfaces — near-black with violet undertone ties it to the brand

soft-violet.$description: Soft Violet — Icon strokes, decorative SVG borders, illustration outlines — the muted cousin of the brand color, used where saturated indigo would be too loud

pale-lavender.$description: Pale Lavender — Badge accent border, decorative illustration strokes — provides warmth without competing with the primary

sunlit-yellow.$description: Sunlit Yellow — Decorative badge fill, section eyebrow pills, highlight wash — a single warm note against the cool indigo system

pale-lilac.$description: Pale Lilac — Subtle button surface, card hover wash, ghost UI background — the lightest tint of the brand violet

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary page canvas, card surface, button text, image backgrounds

frost-gray.$description: Frost Gray — Alternate section background, subtle surface lift above white, badge surface

slate.$description: Slate — Body text borders, hairline dividers, card outlines — the structural neutral

graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary text on light surfaces, nav text, button text — high-contrast reading color

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary text, image borders, link text on white

stone.$description: Stone — Muted helper borders, inactive UI outlines

fog.$description: Fog — Nav dividers, inactive nav text, subtle UI separators

satoshi.$description: Sole typeface across the entire system — Satoshi 700 for display and headings, Satoshi 500 for body, labels, and buttons. The geometric, slightly rounded letterforms feel modern but not trendy; the tight -0.02em tracking at all sizes gives everything a compact, engineered quality. Use Inter as a freely available substitute; Geist is also close.
